NPC-HUD mockups 1: the one-page NPC sheet

1. The one-page NPC sheet2 to 4. The HUD5. The bottom of the screen

A second NPC sheet for experienced GMs (the current sheet stays). The Main tab is the whole stat block; Build, Effects and Notes are the other tabs. The numbers are the Bestiary's Stage 0 examples; the Health is pack HP's model (one HP bar, the Vigor and Resolve gauges, which can go below 0). The choice here: (a) full text or (b) one line. Both use the same header, stat block, bands and Version buttons: a click on the amber button opens the roll dialog, a right-click on a row opens the Action card.

Orc Warrior (Standard), mid-fight: 14 Vigor lost

(a) Full text, with the Tier table Alternative

Everything is read on the sheet: traits, Target, Distance, Vs., the three Tiers side by side (a one-Version Action's Tier table, turned on its side).
